voice.text: Rain and ran. What are a and i doing? Tap your guess.
You can spot teams and bossy r!
Find the two letters that share one voice.
Yes. A team. First vowel talks.
When two vowels go walking, the first one talks.
Bossy r grabs the vowel. ar, or, er.
ai in rain says… /ă/, or /ā/, or /ī/

r in farm is… just /r/ after /ă/, or bossy — it grabs a, or silent
ran vs rain — what changed? A vowel team was added, or A blend melted, or Magic e
